theorems.name: Submission.idtp_ccd_sfv_mult_ae_eq_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n) (p : Euclid P) (ρ : ℝ) (k : ℕ), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → (∀ y ∈ T.support, y ∈ ball p ρ → HasMassDensity T y k) → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, x ∈ ball p ρ → R.mult x = k) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R.carrier ∩ ball p ρ)), R.mult x = k
